Native /api/session/:id/prompt and an actual PTY OpenCode TUI with --prompt both reached a saved assistant error: provider.auth, HTTP 403, free tier can only be used from within OpenCode. The earlier manually selected interactive free-model turn remains a narrow historical pass; it does not establish automation or availability now.
free_provider.decision: No paid provider is authorized. Do not route user projects or frozen automated evaluation to this unreliable free tier.
